requirements.verbatim_text: Responses Due: August 26, 2026 by 10:30 a.m. Central Time
Prior to award of the Contract, Respondent must obtain TX-RAMP Level 2 certification.
The VDOT solution must support both real-time video observation (Synchronous VDOT) and recorded video submission for later review (Asynchronous VDOT).

The system must allow secure transmission of protected health information, support use on mobile devices, and reduce the need for routine travel associated with in-person observation while maintaining required treatment monitoring.

Implementing a VDOT program requires adherence to all current, approved DSHS Standing Delegation Orders (SDOs), Standing Medical Orders (SMOs) and must follow federal and state privacy and security laws.
Commencing on the Effective Date and during the Contract Term, Contractor must provide Services that comply with TX-RAMP Certification Level 2.

The Contractor shall comply with Exhibit N, Requirements Traceability Matrix, that provides a detailed Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) that defines and organizes all required Services and technical requirements to be fulfilled by the Contractor.
The Contractor, for no additional compensation, shall conduct on an annual basis a Disaster Recovery test to assess the effectiveness of the Contractor’s Disaster Recovery Plan.
On or before the ninetieth (90th) Calendar Day following each Disaster Recovery test, Contractor will provide DSHS, with a written summary report detailing the results of the Disaster Recovery test.
Upon DSHS’s written request, Contractor shall make Contractor personnel available to discuss with DSHS the results of the Disaster Recovery test.
Contractor shall use commercially reasonable efforts to resolve issues identified during the Disaster Recovery test.
for each unsuccessful test, Contractor shall conduct an additional Disaster Recovery test in a timely manner to validate the successful implementation of Contractor’s remediation activities.
The Contractor shall submit an invoice to DSHS in a format consistent with the line-item descriptions of Exhibit M, Cost Proposal.
Each invoice submitted must identify: a. The purchase order number; b. HHSC’s Contract number; c. The time period (e.g., month); and d. Line-item description for Service or Deliverable.
Invoices shall be sent to: Health and Human Services Commission Attn: Invoice – HHSC MC2065 4601 W. Guadalupe St. Austin, TX 78751 Fax: (512) 206-4854 E-mail: IT_invoicing@hhs.texas.gov
Respondents must complete and return with their Solicitation Response Exhibit D-1, Attachment 2 to the DUA, Security and Privacy Inquiry (SPI).
Pre-proposal Conference and Subcontracting Plan Training Attendance is Optional JULY 23, 2026, at 10:00 AM Central Time
Deadline for Submitting Questions or Requests for Clarification JULY 24, 2026 at 5:00 PM Central Time
Deadline for courtesy Subcontracting Plan review AUGUST 12, 2026 at 2:00 PM Central Time
Deadline for Submission of Solicitation Responses [NOTE: Responses must be RECEIVED by HHSC by the deadline.] AUGUST 26, 2026 at 10:30 AM Central Time
